title: Article 384 — Provisional provisions as to State Legislatures and related offices (Omitted)

content.overview: Article 384 was a transitional provision relating to State Legislatures and associated offices. Omitted by the Constitution (Seventh Amendment) Act, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Spent; not living law.
content.glance: Art 384 omitted by 7th Amendment 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Transitional State Legislature provision — spent.
content.study: Part of the 379–391 transitional block. Omitted by 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956).

questionsAndAnswers.question: Status of Article 384?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Omitted by the 7th Amendment, 1956 (w.e.f. 1-11-1956). Spent transitional provision.
